summary: Healthcare services in low-resource environments are improved through the Bahmni-core system, a comprehensive electronic medical record and information management system. It is designed for clinics and hospitals, particularly in areas with limited resources. The system aims to enhance patient care and management by providing necessary services for running Bahmni. The beneficiaries are healthcare professionals and patients in low-resource settings. The system addresses the healthcare sector, focusing on improving access to quality medical care.
